title: Stage 1 Intent Contract
description: Machine-readable Stage 1 intent tier. Authored directly as prototype/intent.json. Only fields the Stage 1 frontier owns appear here; Stage 3/4 state taxonomy is deliberately absent so an author cannot mistake a Stage 1 gate for a Stage 3/4 one.

slice_id.description: Bounded slice identifier; names the compiled artifact set.

core_tension.description: The authentic product tension, as `<A> vs <B>` or a full sentence.

declared_surfaces.description: Surface identifiers this slice owns. The first entry is the primary surface.

physical_anchor.description: The real-world object or space whose physicality drives the spatial chassis, or `none` when the product has no device-shaped anchor. An empty value is not a declaration.

five_axes.description: Optional continuous calibration. An unset axis stays open; never filled with a default that would reach the builder as if it were authored.

content_language.description: Locked content language tag, for example `zh-Hans`.
